title: Resend dashboard tabs
description: A centred icon tile, lit title and lead over three hairline tab cards (icon square + tight grotesk label; the chosen one gets a green icon and a glowing line along its bottom edge) and a wide 16px-radius dashboard screenshot slot that crossfades when the tab changes. Tabs stack on phones.
notes: each tab's screenshot is a media slot (1232×659, r16): placeholders until filled
